exposure: sociodemographic characteristics (maternal age, educational attainment, employment status, marital status)
perinatal characteristics (gravidity, parity, gestational age, mode of birth, infant feeding style)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 119 postpartum mothers aged 18 years and above who delivered via normal spontaneous delivery or cesarean section at Silliman University Medical Center.
finding: The study found a significant positive relationship between breastfeeding self-efficacy and readiness for hospital discharge, and self-efficacy to breastfeed was linked to an increased likelihood of exclusively breastfeeding.
cross-section timing: during the postpartum hospital stay, prior to discharge (December 2022 to February 2023)
